newsitem.title: JAPAN: Construction up on extra budget reports.
newsitem.headline: Construction up on extra budget reports.

text.p: Japanese construction shares were firm in Thursday afternoon trade, helped by media reports the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) will ask the new government to compile a five trillion yen supplementary budget, brokers said.

As of 0513 GMT, shares of Haseko Corp were 15 yen higher at 405 yen, ranking 20 on the largest percentage gainer list. Brokers said newspaper reports that the company is forecast to post a parent current profit of 1.8 billion yen in the six months to September 30, after suffering a loss in the same period a year ago, were encouraging.
Officials were not available to comment on the report.
